== Notes ==
* Only affects the nearest target when an attack hits multiple foes, e.g. using [[Barrage]] or with a [[Scythe]].
* Unlike [[Nightmare Weapon]], the unsuccessful attack (e.g. [[miss]]ed or [[Line of sight|obstructed]]) is counted and discharges the skill effect.

==Trivia==
*The tiny frog that appears in the animation is a reference to a poisonous frog that was commonly used to tip arrows with poison.
